description: jurisdictionVenueFilter(jurisdiction, venue, jurisdiction_ok_for_real, kyc_required) carries two vestigial parameters. The documented return semantics (behavioral-spec.md:35, verification-architecture.md:23: 'True IFF jurisdiction_ok_for_real == true AND kyc_required == false') depend solely on the two booleans; jurisdiction and venue are never used in any branch, and every proof obligation (PROP-T14/14b/15/15b/16) ignores them. A pure function intended for formal verification with two dead inputs is a name-vs-behavior mismatch (the function is really bothFlagsClear(ok, kyc)). Non-blocking, but the signature should either drop the unused args or the semantics should actually consult a jurisdiction/venue table.

evidence.snippet: jurisdictionVenueFilter(jurisdiction, venue, jurisdiction_ok_for_real, kyc_required) ... returns true IFF both jurisdiction_ok_for_real == true AND kyc_required == false
